title: Server Timeline (State Age)
description: When features, heroes and pets unlock as the Kingshot server (state) ages, plus how to estimate the server's age.
sources: Kingshot community guide (Server Timeline / State Age)

entries.name: Server age milestones
entries.summary: Server age (in days since state creation) gates when features, hero generations and pet generations unlock. Understanding these milestones helps plan progression.

features: Fog is lifted from Fertile Land
Kingdom becomes eligible for Kingdom of Power
Artisan's Vision in Alliance Championship Store
Gen 2 Heroes become available in Hero Recruitment and Intel Missions
Generation 5 Pets (Great Moose, Alpha Black Panther)
Generation 6 Pets (Regal White Lion, Ironclad War Elephant)

entries.name: How to calculate State Age
entries.summary: Two estimation methods for a server's age: VIP login-day counter, or the Beast Hunting achievement completion date. There is no exact method, only estimates.

methods.detail: Check the VIP tab login counter. If you joined on server creation day and logged in daily, this count approximates the server's age.

Go to the Monument (center of Outer City, or the Events page), find the 'Beast Hunting' achievement (third from top). This achievement completes 6 days after server creation. Subtract 6 days from the completion date to estimate the server creation date.

notes: There is no exact calculation method, only estimates.
Most players join servers on creation day, making login days a reliable metric.
